Read from the BASE ref on every run, never from the PR — a PR must not be able to widen the rules it is judged by. Every key below is OPTIONAL; each omitted key falls back to the SAFE default in packages/factory-gate/src/config.mjs, so a truncated or malformed file produces a gate that refuses to merge rather than one that waves things through.
//allowlistAuthors: Issue authors trusted to define work for the factory. EMPTY (the default) means NOBODY is trusted and every PR escalates — that is deliberate, not a bug.
//requiredLabels: The trust token. Matched case-insensitively across the PR's AND the issue's labels.
//blockingLabels: Any of these on the PR or the issue blocks the merge outright.
//riskPathDenylist: Paths the factory may never auto-merge. Mirror your CODEOWNERS: anything a code owner must approve is something the gate should refuse to land unattended. `.factory/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `.github/CODEOWNERS` and `CODEOWNERS` are added AUTOMATICALLY and cannot be removed by this file — a PR must not be able to edit its own gate, its own CI, or its own reviewers.
//size: A change small enough that CI plus a glance is meaningful review. Missing size data FAILS.
//requireScopeBlock: Every changed file must match a glob in the issue's ```scope block. An issue with NO scope block yields no globs, and no globs means every file is drift — no declared scope is not permission, it is an unfinished spec. Pair this with an issue template that has a required scope field.
//requireGreenCI: Every required context must be present AND conclusive. UNKNOWN is never a pass.
//requireFixtureEvidence: Condition 9, the mechanical-verification dial. Leave FALSE until this repo's reproduction harness has a track record — with no harness it fails every PR. Turning it on is what eventually makes a machine-minted `fix-verified` defensible.
//gateFromRef: The ref the gate config is read from. Keep this as your protected default branch.
